sites.name: Mt Kailash and Lake Manasarovar
sites.what: Sacred mountain and lake in western Tibet. India's MEA-run yatra (20 batches of 50 via Lipulekh and Nathu La in 2026) is for Indian pilgrims; Australians go through the Tibet permit and organised-tour route.

access.permits: Tibet Travel Permit through a China travel agent, organised tour only (see cn/tibet zone requirements); further area permits not yet checked

lore.text: Popular lore calls Kailash Mt Meru, the axis of the world, and a gateway to Shambhala.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.summary: 1 site(s): Mt Kailash and Lake Manasarovar. Facts from official sources; lore labelled as claims.
ancient-sites-and-mysteries.evidence: UNESCO pages and Smartraveller read directly; other official pages are search snapshots unless marked.

layers.process: Get permission from Chinese authorities and a Tibet Entry Permit from the Tibet Tourism Bureau. Applications go only through specialised travel agents in China, and you can only travel as part of an organised tour. Smartraveller says reconsider travel to Gyirong County (flooding, landslides) and exercise a high degree of caution in Tibet.
